hero.title: Keep working on your project.
paragraphs: Your uploaded material, saved documents and current task remain in place while you choose a top-up.

balance.title: Current balance
paragraphs: See the available free and purchased token balance and the task you will return to after payment. The balance may be negative.

packages.title: Choose a top-up
paragraphs: Every package uses the same price of 0.13 roubles per internal token. Larger packages have no discount.

purchase.title: Before payment
paragraphs: Purchased tokens do not expire. After a successful payment, return to your saved upload, document or chat task.

debt.title: When the balance limits new requests
paragraphs: New paid AI requests are restricted at **−2,000 internal tokens or lower**, equivalent to **−USD 2 of provider cost**. A request already in progress settles at its final cost and may take the balance below that threshold.
Top up to bring the balance above −2,000 tokens and continue the saved task.

scope.title: Future services
paragraphs: Landing-page creation and paid server deployment are future capabilities with prices and availability not yet set.

charging.title: How AI requests are charged
paragraphs: One internal token represents USD 0.001 of provider cost. The purchase price includes a thirty per cent margin at a fixed conversion of 100 roubles per dollar. The margin is charged at top-up; model use consumes the balance at provider cost.

One token is charged when your input is sent. A successful answer settles at its actual cost, rounded up to a whole internal token, with a minimum charge of one token, or 0.13 roubles at the purchase price.

refunds.title: Failed requests and refunds
paragraphs: If an AI request fails or is cancelled, every deduction for it is restored, including the initial token and any settlement charge. Its net charge is zero. The service bears any provider expense.
This token reversal is separate from a cash refund for a top-up. Purchases are normally final; cash refunds are decided case by case and are not a published entitlement.

recovery.title: If payment does not complete
paragraphs: A failed or cancelled payment leaves your saved work and token balance unchanged. Check the payment result, try again or ask for support. You can also return to the workspace without buying.

success.title: Package selected
paragraphs: Review the selected amount and token total. You can choose a different package or return to your workspace.
